selected_script.angle: A kitchen efficiency hack showing how a heavy 2.65lb non-slip paper towel stand enables effortless one-handed tearing while keeping a cleaner spray instantly accessible.
selected_script.hook: This heavy-duty kitchen gadget just saved me from the ultimate messy countertop disaster.

segment_01.voiceover: This heavy-duty kitchen gadget just saved me from the ultimate messy countertop disaster. Watch how it stays perfectly still.
segment_01.visual_description: A female creator stands in a modern kitchen. She places a jumbo paper towel roll onto the solid matte black Ultrean paper towel holder on a marble countertop. The base remains completely stable.

segment_02.voiceover: The weighted base and tension arm let you tear sheets with just one hand. No tipping, no unraveling, just total control.
segment_02.visual_description: Close-up of the creator's hand pulling and tearing a single sheet of paper towel with one hand. The spring-loaded tension arm holds the roll firmly, preventing tipping.

segment_03.voiceover: And the best part? Press the top button to unlock a hidden spray bottle inside the center rod for instant cleanup!
segment_03.visual_description: The creator presses the top lock button, pulls out the hidden transparent 4oz spray bottle from the black outer sleeve, and sprays a fine mist onto the countertop.

broll_coverage.visual_description: Detailed close-up showing the assembled matte black stand, followed by the transparent spray bottle being pulled out from the solid black center rod.
